name: WATRFauc_Hydrophone Slow Fill 4L Plastic Bucket Resonant Stream Clicks_TidbitAudio_BigAmp_CSRMM_44100_16-001
description:
Fluid Resonance - Experimental Hydrophone Container Recordings
Recorded exclusively inside contained vessels with a specialized hydrophone.
Premium, raw recordings bypassing the air to capture changing fluid vibrations and liquid resonance. Produced for game audio, cinematic tension, and experimental sound design.
    • 🎧 High-Fidelity | Chain & Specs: TidbitAudio Hydrophone ➔ Triton BigAmp Piezo Pre ➔ Zoom F3 | 32-bit Float / 192kHz WAV.
    • 📦 Features: Shifting pitches, liquid chugs, metallic thermos rings, and hollow plastic acoustics across 1L, 4L, and 20L volumes. 22 clips total.
        • 🏷️ Workflow Ready: UCS-compliant naming conventions for instant organization in Soundminer, BaseHead, or Reaper.
